title: Cheap, thinnest curtain I've ever seen
text: Cheap, thinnest curtain I've ever seen. I'm extremely displeased with the quality of these curtains. I wouldn't even consider it a curtain personally more like a vail material.  Not what I had in mind what so ever. Thankfully Amazon has great Cuisinart service and I was able to return them for new ones Unless your looking for the thinnest cheapest looking curtain I don't recommend unless If you want something you can see right through, then these are it!
